name: Midnight Subway Aquarium
description: An empty late-night subway car becomes a glowing underwater aquarium filled with fish and drifting seagrass.
prompt: An empty midnight subway car transformed into an underwater aquarium, neon interior reflections on shallow water, glowing koi, angelfish, seagrass along seats, mist, moody blue and pink light, cinematic perspective, photorealistic surreal, ultra detailed, no text, no logos, no watermarks
caption: The last train of the night becomes a secret ocean. What animal should live in your empty hallway?
